levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Warm-up questions are generic ('is it good?', 'any feedback?') rather than aimed at a specific aspect of the draft.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both warm-up questions target a specific aspect of the draft (e.g., clarity of the opening, whether the ending lands).

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Questions are specific enough that the summarized feedback in t2 clearly answers each one directly.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Revision described in t3 does not clearly trace back to feedback recorded in t2.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Revision clearly traces back to specific feedback received.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Revision meaningfully improves the draft beyond a surface word swap, addressing the substance of the feedback.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection states feedback was easy or fine with no reasoning.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a specific reaction to the feedback and explains the reasoning behind accepting or not accepting a piece of it.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection shows genuine weighing of the feedback against the learner's own intent for the piece.

lookFors: The two prepared questions were actually asked, per the t2 checklist item.
Feedback summarized in t2 is attributable to a real conversation, not invented after the fact.
Only the document and the two questions were shared with the trusted adult, per the safety notes.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
